scope: Unbiased source-free-start native origin under EXACT unchanged M8.0 B/H laws; no artificial B/H bonds at t0, no planted template, no engineered offspring, no spontaneous-life claims.

physics.initial_condition: 20 independent free UNBONDED monomers (10 of species 0, 10 of species 1) uniformly assigned without replacement to 20 of 50 lattice cells by deterministic blake2b site ranking; bits randomly assigned with deterministic blake2b rank at same numeric seed; remove 10 of each from finite bath of 40 each. No initial B/H, all initial IDs at tick 0, initial total mass 80 and energy 500. No genome/template chosen; no post hoc seeding. Exactly same starting state for each paired control seed.

frozen_campaign.units_of_independence: 64 numeric source seed worlds, not daughter events or different control arms
frozen_campaign.random_lottery: M8.0 keyed draws; independent initialization hash only at tick 0, same positions/species across all three modes

endpoints.first_native_4: At each tick after native physics step, scan each horizontal contiguous 4-site window on all rows lexicographically by (y,x). Count source if all 4 persistent IDs were placed as FREE unbonded initial material, and all 3 currently extant B edges were native B_form events with no seeded bonds. Choose earliest tick, then y,x and material IDs; save full species sequence. Do not choose an advantageous candidate retrospectively. No initial bonds are permitted.
endpoints.first_native_4_rate: World-level count of at least one first-native-4 in no_template arm; all 64 seeds included.
endpoints.material_product: Only AFTER first source formation, for a row directly above or below source and exactly aligned four x positions: four DIFFERENT material IDs, each created by a real adsorb event AFTER source origin with source_material_id equal to source ID at matching x, physically B-connected by 3 real B_form edges, no H contact between any daughter material and ANY source material at observation, and the entire B-connected daughter component is EXACTLY 4 material IDs. All four stay the same IDs and species with that isolated topology at least 20 consecutive ticks. Count at most once per source world, no manual offspring assignment.
endpoints.informative_product: material_product plus exact 4-bit daughter species string equals original first source species string; provide H/capture/B formation provenance and mismatch counts, no visual-similarity-only ancestry.
endpoints.opportunity_audit: Record first source tick, B-form events, number of genuine source->daughter monomer H captures, and total material captures/B forms; note mode opportunity imbalance without making rate-match claims from global totals alone.

frozen_decision.integrity: All 192 worlds finish with full exact matter/energy invariants each tick, 0 t0 B/H, fixed 20 monomers 10/10, deterministic replay; a failure means implementation invalid, not scientific NO_GO.
frozen_decision.origin_go: At least 12 of 64 no_template seed worlds display first_native_4 by tick 200. If not, report nucleation barrier NO_GO, do not enlarge seed list without a new protocol.
frozen_decision.informational_go: At least 4/64 templated source worlds have informative_product, and at least 3 more worlds than shuffled_identity have informative_product. If not, report NO_GO / unproven informative origin even if ordinary native B structures appear.
frozen_decision.null_logic: All zero cases stay in denominator; success thresholds never relaxed after outcomes. No interpretation as three-generation inheritance or life.

notes: M8.1a tests static adsorption-surface nucleation only, NOT mobile diffusion, metabolism, heritable multigeneration or natural chemistry realism.
M8.0 files, historical M6/M7 physics, and master must remain untouched.
Any revised initial geometry/density, new diffusion rule or more seeds requires a separately versioned preregistration; never modify this frozen protocol.
